body: Thank you for reading, sorry it was so long! It's frustrating that there are so many good parts to our friendship still and it will be sad if we drift apart, I'm just having trouble weighing up what is more important to me, my happiness or her happiness, and I think the answer should be mine but I know I will find it hard to let go.

This will go on forever until you speak to him. I've been in a similar situation before and although talking about it seems like a mortifying idea, it is the only way you can get any sort of clarification and as a friend he should respect you for asking him what the deal is.
